comments.note: The mutation-path ACs (reset action, cancel, skip, missing in decisions, mixed decisions, root index updates, project comment, pipeline preservation) are covered by api-reset.test.ts integration tests rather than standalone applyProjectReset unit tests. project-reset.test.ts focuses solely on analyzeProjectForReset. This split is acceptable — the mutation logic is exercised end-to-end via 13 integration tests, and the unit-test file for analysis is thorough. A dedicated applyProjectReset unit test would improve isolation but is not a blocker.

makeWp and makeRootIndex helper factories keep test fixtures DRY and minimal. auto_cancelled exclusion is correctly tested by pushing a pipeline with auto_cancelled: true and asserting it does not appear in pipeline_stages_present. The most-recent-wins semantic is verified with a FAIL-then-PASS sequence for the same type.
